Container.Name: wars-relay
Container.Overview: The schmitz-wars relay with the web game baked in: rooms, an append-only log per game (the saved games), forwarding between the two players, and the exported game served on the same origin. Built by GitHub Actions from the repo on every push to main. Only /data is mounted. NPM Plus proxy host: wars.schmitzplex.com -> http://[unraid ip]:8787, Websockets Support ON, no Authelia.

Config.Name: Relay port
Config.Description: The relay's HTTP + WebSocket port. NPM Plus forwards wars.schmitzplex.com here.

Config.Name: Data (rooms and logs)
Config.Description: Every room's meta.json and log.jsonl. This IS the saved games. Back it up like any appdata.

Config.Name: PORT
Config.Description: Port the relay listens on inside the container. Keep in step with the port mapping.

Config.Name: DATA_DIR
Config.Description: Where the relay writes rooms/ (the Data path above).

Config.Name: STATIC_DIR
Config.Description: Where the web game inside the image is served from. Empty = relay only, no game files.
